editorial:
You are dropped into a tense dinner party where every bite feels dangerous. Fish has just left prison after six years, and the four men he protected want answers about missing diamonds. The meal is served on a naked woman who seems frozen in place, which makes the room feel even stranger. The movie keeps you watching because the setup is simple but loaded with bad blood, secrets, and threats.

The acting is the big draw, especially the loud, scary energy from the thieves and Fish's worn-down calm. The pacing stays tight, though the torture scenes can be rough and the story sometimes feels like a stage play. If you like dark crime thrillers with one-room tension, this is worth a late-night watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Fish finally admits the diamonds were hidden with the sushi girl all along. She drops her frozen act, turns on the thieves, and escapes with the loot. Fish is left behind as the dinner party collapses into violence, giving the story a nasty last twist that changes who was really in control. The last shot leaves you wondering if anyone truly won, since the money only moves the danger to a new place.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves one-room crime thrillers with nasty twists.
